purpose: Consolidate the current technical state of the controlled property fixture revalidation chain without converting technical status into legal verification or publication readiness.

open_blocker.required_action: Obtain or explicitly approve a corrected/replacement controlled fixture before dependent revalidation.

rules: Do not execute dependent revalidation before the prerequisite is satisfied.
Do not treat synthetic fixtures as live official property evidence.
Do not upgrade legal verification through technical validation.
Do not upgrade publication readiness through technical validation.
guardrails: No live official property record is claimed.
No real property ownership or title is established.
